ui_checks: Continuous cursor inspection below the plot, stable domain while scrubbing, account/metric toggles and provider-filter selection preservation
Bounded pinch zoom and time-axis pan; smoothing and averaged rate comparisons
Single combined Activity heatmap and selected-day account breakdown
Copilot additional budget/unlimited counters, Grok spending, Gemini remaining count panels
Selection outside plot bounds, reset event sheets, 90-day view and daily/monthly heatmaps
validation.iterations: Early runs found a non-tappable account-row spacer, corrected currency/header/element queries, and an ambiguous DisclosureGroup identifier. Material UI fixes and precise queries passed in the final run. A diagnostic print was removed from the UI test afterward; product code is unchanged.

charts.sparse_level_bridges: Faint straight endpoint connections within the same known allowance cycle; no inspected or stored intermediate readings.
charts.reset_transitions: Explicit right-angle render points; no smoothing across cycles.
charts.smoothing: Render-only simplification, followed by an explicitly sampled bounded Hermite curve. The readout uses that curve and marks estimates against raw observations.
charts.rate_gap_limit: Smaller of 6 hours or the quota duration; unknown, unit and allowance changes break runs.
charts.combined_activity: One quota per account within a selected window class. Percentage changes average known accounts; compatible amount consumption sums. Unknown values remain unknown.

provider_observations.grok_new_detail: Reported onDemandUsed Cent amount shown as USD, even without a positive spending cap.
provider_observations.gemini_new_detail: Reported remainingAmount retained beside remainingFraction; no inferred entitlement or used counter.
provider_observations.copilot_new_details: Finite and unlimited counters; additional-budget usage and enabled state; compatible counter units.
history_new_fields: numeric provider details and credit availability
provider_observations.cursor_follow_up: Current free response inspected. Spend-limit units and model capability semantics were not established, so additional currency totals or model-access claims were not invented.

design_review.final_verdict: All four material fixes confirmed; no remaining shipping blockers identified in reviewed sources and screenshots.
findings_resolved: Sparse level traces separated from rate gap policy
Short-window rate continuity with reset drops excluded
Combined Activity avoids double-counting multiple quota windows per account
Cached inspection rendering and stable reset-marker lane
Real axis gesture space and full account-row hit target
Shared explicit smooth curve for drawing and inspection

limits: History still depends on successful provider refreshes; iOS controls background delivery.
Long unknown intervals and unobserved resets cannot establish consumption. Sparse endpoint bridges are visual only.
Provider amounts and currencies are shown only where understood; not all providers expose token or model counters.
Native provider login protocols did not change. Gemini and Grok additions were checked with fixtures, not a new live sign-in in this release.
Home and Lock Screen widget code did not change; physical-device system rendering and long-term background cadence remain manual checks.
